correctness.rationale: The single cheaper transport route supplies an exact piecewise norm in every sign chamber. Independent uniform composition coordinates imply an explicit beta survival law and a common 1/t chamber-volume multiplier; Vandermonde sums the chambers. Independently, equally voluminous ordering simplices in the equilateral dual give a Dirichlet gap law and exact quadratic polar volume. Differentiation establishes the unique maximum for all real parameters and all dimensions at least three. Twelve exact-rational finite polytope computations corroborate both volumes; they are not the proof of the infinite family.
